sources.title: 證券商公會 115 年 7 月 10 日巴威颱風集中市場休市公告
TPEx 115 年 4 月 3 日及 4 月 6 日休市公告

notes: Exclude Saturdays and Sundays separately; this list is not an exhaustive list of weekend dates.
Scheduled closures cover calendar year 2026. Exceptional closures are a reference snapshot as of 2026-09-24 and must be reviewed before extending a backfill beyond that date.
2026-02-12 and 2026-02-13 are settlement-only days and have no exchange trading.
The published annual TWSE schedule alone omits the 2026-07-10 typhoon closure; it is included using the securities association's public announcements.
Local weather-related office closures do not necessarily close the whole market; do not infer market closure from a county office closure alone.
